name: Build role-specific context
description: Generate per-role perspective files so each agent role loads knowledge, facts, and rules relevant to its viewpoint — not everything.
whenToUse: When agents need role-scoped context to avoid cognitive overload and hallucination from mixed perspectives.

team.perspective: Map which facts, patterns, and rules are relevant to each agent role based on their mission and viewpoint.
Challenge over-inclusion — ensure each role gets only what it needs, not everything. Prevent cognitive overload.
Write focused perspective files per role following the knowledge structure convention.

texts.perspective-rules:
## Role-Scoped Context Rules

**Goal:** Each role loads ONLY context relevant to its viewpoint. A combined context of all perspectives causes hallucination and subjectivity (research: knowledge-accumulation-patterns.md).

**Perspective file structure** (`.claude/context/perspectives/<role>.md`):
```yaml
---
type: perspective
source: agent:<role>
confidence: verified
scope: role:<role>
updated: YYYY-MM-DD
---
```

**Content per perspective:**
- **Lens**: What this role focuses on
- **Relevant facts**: Which facts/* files matter to this role
- **Relevant patterns**: Which design patterns this role applies
- **Rules**: Role-specific constraints when designing/debating/implementing
- **Red flags**: What this role watches for

**Access rule:** An agent reads `facts/*` + `decisions/*` (shared) + its OWN `perspectives/<role>.md`. It does NOT read other roles' perspectives.

**Optimal scope:** 2-3 reference points per role. More causes coordination overload.
texts.available-roles:
## Agent Roles to Build Perspectives For

Based on templates/agents/:
- **architect**: System boundaries, integration, data flow, scalability
- **engineer**: Implementation feasibility, effort, risk, TDD
- **pm**: User value, scope, priorities
- **reviewer**: Code/artifact quality
- **skeptic**: Devil's advocate, challenges assumptions
- **synthesizer**: Drives to consensus, writes decisions
- **red-team**: Offensive security
- **blue-team**: Defensive security
- **sre-lead**: Reliability, operations
- **compliance**: Regulatory adherence
- **investigator**: Root cause analysis
- **advocate**: Argues for proposals

phases.title: Inventory available knowledge
phases.goal: Mapper reads all facts/ files and lists the knowledge available to distribute across roles.
instructions: List each fact/pattern and tag which roles would care about it
Note the project's domain and key technical concerns
Identify roles that are actually used in this project's workflows

phases.title: Scope each role's context
phases.goal: Debate what each role needs. Challenger prevents over-inclusion; Mapper ensures nothing critical is missed.
instructions: For each role, propose its relevant facts/patterns/rules
Challenger: cut anything not directly tied to the role's lens
Keep each perspective to 2-3 key reference points
Agree on the final scope per role
Flag roles that don't need a perspective file (handled by shared facts)

phases.title: Write perspective files
phases.goal: Writer creates focused perspective files for each role that needs one.
instructions: Create .claude/context/perspectives/<role>.md for each role needing scoped context
Follow the perspective file structure with proper header
Include: lens, relevant facts, relevant patterns, rules, red flags
Keep focused — 2-3 reference points per role
List which roles use shared facts only (no perspective file needed)

triggers: A role's scope is ambiguous and needs user input
Two roles have overlapping concerns that need boundary clarification
